$comment: When the branded bell-shaped Coca-Cola glass appears. Rule: any SKU larger than 1 L requires at least one glass, so the intake Y/N is answered Y and locked. For SKUs of 1 L or less, the operator's intake Y/N (sku.glass) decides. Every place setting gets a glass whenever glasses are in the scene. Owned by the Operating Unit's brand rules.

glass.label: GLASS
glass.description: Branded bell-shaped Coca-Cola glass, poured from the SKU, with or without ice.

required_when.effect: glass required: intake Y/N pre-set to Y and locked

otherwise.effect: operator chooses with the intake Y/N (default N)

per_diner.$comment: Every place setting stays identical: when glasses are in the scene, each diner gets one.

shared_bottle.$comment: PROPOSED, to confirm. A SKU larger than 1 L is a shareable bottle, so a 2-person scene shows ONE bottle for the table (in the center third, between the settings) and one glass per diner, instead of a large bottle per diner.
